_comment: Curated entity registry for the two PDFs and the GIAN Nidhi page context. 'aliases' are exact surface forms found in the sources (used for mention detection and query-time entity linking). 'documents' scopes where an alias may be matched, so identical first names in different sources are never merged by string similarity. 'description' only restates what the sources say. GIAN Nidhi institutions, participants and projects are generated programmatically from the cleaned CSV.

entities.name: Rameshwar Lal / Rameshwar Prasad (name differs between Part I and Part II)
entities.description: Part I (p.14): 'Shri Rameshwar Prasad Ji' - grafting techniques with the Khejri tree and the discovery of 14 different varieties including a thornless Khejri. Part II (pp.2, 4): 'Rameshwar Lal ji' - developed a thornless variety of Khejri (Prosopis cineraria) through grafting and collected seeds from a tree that flowered in a dry year.
entities.link_note: Linked as one person with status 'probable': both mentions are tied to the same specific innovation (thornless Khejri via grafting) in the same Shodhyatra; the middle name conflicts (Prasad vs Lal) and is unresolved.
